chips.title: Agent CLI comparison harness
chips.summary: V2 unattended comparison complete: six valid task passes and three repeatability gates. Independent Chromium checks pass. Supervised counts and blind cleanup remain later.

evidence.message: Spec committed 2026-08-01 and marked not implemented; it needs its own harness and lane registry, not the wave controller.
On 2026-10-22 one instrumented agy lane replaced both the retiring Gemini CLI lane and the hand-run Antigravity IDE lane in the spec.
Harness built; pins verified. Claude/Codex repeat gates pass; agy denied git log after approved bounded fixes. Four valid trials; no cross-lane conclusion.
Git log grant applied; Windows regex runs Python/Git. Batches 6-8 excluded: denials. Batch 8 linked Git metadata blocked; targeted read-only fix awaits approval. 15 tests pass.
Metadata grant approved; pinned system PowerShell runs Python and Git history. Batches 9-11 excluded after command denials. Sandbox and URL/MCP denies retained.
Batch 12: agy-1 timed out at 600.7s during Playwright startup; agy-2 denied fixture search. Both excluded. Same-home Playwright works outside agy; 19 harness tests pass.
Exact fixture-search correction tested, not live-verified. Two valid agy repeats still missing; supervised approval counts and blind cleanup scoring remain a later phase.
V2 moves browser checks to the independent verifier. Six fresh trials pass tests and Chromium; all three repeatability gates pass. V1 scores preserved; 34 harness tests pass.
First v2 agy attempt excluded after multiline Python denial. Corrected matching stays within the Python grant; a new agy pair passes. No subject browser run required.
